title: Bananas & Cream Bread – MJCT’s Version
preamble:
¼ cup water and 1 tablespoon water

3 tablespoons powdered milk

1½ tablespoons sugar

1½ teaspoons salt

1½ tablespoons olive oil
ingredients: ¼ cup water and 1 tablespoon water
method: Add all ingredients except the sultanas and bake on normal bread cycle.
At the beeper add the sultanas (29 minutes after start!).
